emptyDesc: An automation hands a saved prompt to a worker on a schedule, in a folder you choose.
masterOff: Automations are turned off in the settings: none of them runs on its schedule.
deleteDesc: The automation and its run history go. Tasks it started stay.

cronWords.monthly: on day {days} of every month | on days {days} of every month

card.requested: The lead asked to turn this on. Review what it runs, then turn it on.
card.unconfirmed: Not confirmed: it cannot run, now or on its schedule, until you review what it runs and turn it on.

editor.desc: A saved prompt handed to a worker on a schedule. It is saved off: you turn it on after reviewing it.
editor.name: Name
editor.promptHint: What the worker is asked to do on each run.
editor.cwdHint: The absolute path the worker runs in.
editor.cronError: A cron expression has five fields.
editor.timezoneHint: local, or a zone such as Europe/Berlin.
editor.laneHint: Files and folders the worker may change, one per line.
editor.noLaneDesc: The worker may change any file in the folder.
editor.precheckHint: Runs in the folder before each run (60 s at most); a non-zero exit skips the run.
editor.minRemainingHint: Skip the run when the best account has less left than this.
editor.graceHint: A run missed while Seelegent was off still starts if it is at most this late.
editor.beforeResetDesc: Also run once when a weekly quota resets within a day with at least 40 % left.
editor.turnsOff: This changes what a run does: the automation turns off until you confirm it again.
editor.savedNew: Automation saved. It is off until you turn it on.
editor.timezoneError: Seelegent does not know this time zone. Use local or a zone such as Europe/Berlin.

confirm.title: Turn on this automation?
confirm.desc: It will run on its own, on this schedule, with no one watching. Check every line.
confirm.quotaText: Skips when less than {pct} is left
confirm.warn: The prompt above is exactly what each run sends. If anything here is not what you expect, cancel and edit it.

runs.title: Runs of {name}
runs.emptyDesc: Runs appear here when the schedule fires or you run it now.

cronError.count: A cron expression has 5 fields (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week); this one has {n}.
cronError.value: In the {field} field, “{value}” is not a number or a name.
cronError.part: In the {field} field, “{value}” is not a value, a range or a list.
cronError.step: In the {field} field, the step “{value}” must be a whole number of 1 or more.
cronError.never: This schedule never runs: no date matches it.

run.starting: Another run of this automation was already starting.
run.taskRunning: The task of its last run has not finished yet ({status}).
run.quotaBackend: The best {backend} account has {left} left; this automation needs at least {min}.
run.quotaBucket: The weekly quota of {account} that resets soon has {left} left; this automation needs at least {min}.
run.saidSkip: The precheck exited with code {code}: nothing to do this time.
run.timedOut: The command did not finish within {limit}.
run.late: Seelegent was off when it was due: {late} late, more than its {grace} grace period.

changed.changed: The automation was edited while its precheck ran, so nothing was started. Review and turn it on to run the new version.
changed.unconfirmed: The automation is not confirmed as it is now, so nothing was started. Review and turn it on.
changed.disabled: The automation was turned off while its precheck ran, so nothing was started.
changed.master_off: Automations were turned off in Settings while the precheck ran, so nothing was started.

run.memberMissing: The member "{member}" no longer exists. Edit the automation to pick another member or a backend.
run.memberDisabled: The member "{member}" is turned off. Turn it on on the Members page, or edit the automation to pick another.
run.interrupted: Seelegent stopped while this run was starting, so it may have started a task: check the task list. It is not run again on its own; use Run now if it is still needed.
